      • LIGHT_FLASH_NONE

        public static final int LIGHT_FLASH_NONE

        Flash type (must sync with vendor.elo.hardware.oemlight.V1_0.Flash)

        Note:

        LIGHT_ID_NFC: support all flash type

        LIGHT_ID_SCR: support flash type LIGHT_FLASH_NONE and LIGHT_FLASH_TIMED, not support LIGHT_FLASH_HARDWARE

        LIGHT_ID_INDCATION: support all flash type.

      • setFlashing

        public void setFlashing​(int oemLightId,
                        int color,
                        int mode,
                        int onMS,
                        int offMS)
        Software flash LED device with color and timer
        Parameters:
        oemLightId - one of LIGHT_ID_XXX of com.elotouch.elopay.library.EloPeripheralManager.OemLights
        color - is The color of the LED in ARGB.
        mode - is the flash type, one of LIGHT_FLASH_XXX of com.elotouch.elopay.library.EloPeripheralManager.OemLights
        onMS - LED on timer in milliseconds.
        offMS - LED off timer in milliseconds.

        Note:

        LIGHT_ID_NFC: support flash type LIGHT_FLASH_NONE and LIGHT_FLASH_TIMED.

        LIGHT_ID_SCR: support flash type LIGHT_FLASH_NONE and LIGHT_FLASH_TIMED

        LIGHT_ID_INDCATION: support flash type LIGHT_FLASH_NONE and LIGHT_FLASH_TIMED
